content_sections.heading: KVAFSU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the KVAFSU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download KVAFSU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator: Graduate with 1-year Diploma course in computer application with one year experience in the related field. Laboratory Technician: Graduate in Medical Laboratory Technology from a recognized University/ Institute/ Hospital, Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) with the course of at least 2 years duration, Diploma/ Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) with at least one year duration, Diploma in Animal Husbandry with at least 2 years duration. Desirable experience for various categories as specified in the notification.

content_sections.text: For all posts, age limits are not explicitly restricted in the notification; please refer to official guidelines for detailed requirements.

content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator: Rs. 20,000/ - per month Laboratory Technician: Rs. 30,000/ - per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KVAFSU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University (KVAFSU).

faq.question: Q2. What are the positions available under KVAFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Data Entry Operator and Laboratory Technician under contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Data Entry Operator and Laboratory Technician posts combined.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for KVAFSU Jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator post is Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Laboratory Technician?
faq.answer: The salary for the Laboratory Technician post is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are required for the Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Medical Laboratory Technology, a Diploma in MLT, or a Diploma in Animal Husbandry.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: Candidates should check the official notification PDF for the exact reporting venue address in Shivamogga, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational and experience certificates, a brief bio-data, and one set of self-attested photocopies.
